Pass `false` if this a development render to not count it as a billable render on remotion.pro. Only can be used in conjuction with `licenseKey`.

## CLI flag

Use `--is-production` with the following commands. Follow a command link for its syntax and examples.

| Command                                             | Flag              |
| --------------------------------------------------- | ----------------- |
| [`remotion lambda render`](/docs/lambda/cli/render) | `--is-production` |
| [`remotion lambda still`](/docs/lambda/cli/still)   | `--is-production` |
